notes: stamped, not written; small bracket marks flank the figures and the right one is over-inked into a blob, so a further figure there cannot be wholly excluded. Read as 28.1.25 on the pattern of the identically stamped 27125 on sw740gd4329. Region 5 is the printed leader label (Welte-Mignon No. 10, The harmonious Blacksmith, Handel).
modern felt-tip on the leader, a playing time and the date it was taken, 30 July 2004. Not a punch date. Regions 1, 2, 4, 5 blank.
stamped; three short slashes of the stamp's bracket precede the figures. All five figures plain, read 8.12.24.

faint pencil, steeply slanted. In this hand 4 and 7 differ only in whether the short stroke sits at the top of the descender or crosses it at mid height; on that test the day ends in 7 and the month and the year's last figure are 4, but 24.7.14 cannot be ruled out. A separate cursive 28 stands in region 4 and again on the printed label (Klavierconcert A moll Op. 54, Schumann, gespielt v. Eug. Adam-Benard), so it is a copy number, not a date.

thin pencil, no separators. Read 12.8.22. The terminal 2 carries a downward curl, the same form as the closing 2 of 16522 on py987gg6088; a reading of 9 there would give 12.8.29 but seems less likely. Region 2 carries two small cursive characters, not a date.
nothing written in any of the three regions; the dark specks near the edge are foxing, region 2 is the colour target.
pencil, no separators, all five figures plain. Read 16.5.22. Regions 1-3 blank.
stamped, with a small bracket mark at each end of the figures. Read 27.1.25.

pencil, no separators. Read 14.9.22. The third figure is an oval with a descending tail, so 9 rather than 0, which a month position would in any case exclude. Region 1 holds a flourished cursive monogram, possibly initials, that I could not read.
pencil, separating dots written out; the month is a crossed 7.
region 1 shows two groups of faint diagonal hatch marks and region 2 a faint squiggle, neither legible as writing; possibly offset from an adjacent wrap. Region 3 is the colour target.
ink. The date line is plain. A second name stands below it in a smaller hand with an umlaut stroke; I read it as Wössler, with less certainty than the rest.
ink, every figure plain; Sph. follows the date and Wössler is written below it.
no writing in any region. Region 1 shows only the printed leader label (Welte-Mignon No. 122, Lohengrin Prelude, R. Wagner, played by E. Adam-Benard); regions 2 and 3 are bare paper.
